dataset_name: UPSC All-Exam Source-Backed Corpus Starter Kit
scope: All UPSC examination families represented in the official Previous Exam Details registry; current historic snapshot years 2012-2027. Future notices are not PYQs.

third_party_answer_key_discovery.authority: Independent discovery index only; not an official source of truth

important_limitations: The local environment had no outbound DNS/network access, so the full 240-exam / 2,478-document live registry sync could not be run into the SQLite file.
The SQLite file is a seed database. Run upsc_corpus_builder.py sync on a networked machine to fill the full source document index.
No question text, options, answer letters, or explanations have been fabricated or inserted as official PYQs.
PDF extraction output is a candidate only and requires human review before publication.
Official answer-key records are incomplete in the registry; answer-key PDFs must be retrieved, matched to the exam/paper/test series, and checked manually.
Generated practice questions belong in practice_questions and must never be counted as official PYQs.
